confidence_notes: Local price reports provide useful food, coffee, and beer benchmarks. Cocktail prices are less certain; wine is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Hostel estimates vary and seasonal demand can be substantial. Hotel anchors are holistic regional estimates, not based on live hotel listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used; food and drink estimates use Inverness price benchmarks, while hotel estimates reflect the Scottish Highlands visitor market.
